concerns.text: Tasks T050-T055 (Reviewer Response & Mechanistic Refinement) implement specific architectural changes (STM/LTM pathways, Uncertainty Module, Dentate Gyrus/CA3 separation) but lack explicit [FR-NNN] or [SC-NNN] tags. The spec.md defines FR-001 through FR-007 only. These tasks address reviewer comments not yet codified as Functional Requirements in the current spec, creating orphan work that cannot be traced to an authorized requirement. A missing task for the new requirements implied by these tasks (e.g., 'System MUST distinguish STM/LTM') means the spec is incomplete for the planned work.

Task T023.1 mandates halting with E001 if 'event_boundaries' are missing from ROCStories. The spec.md (Edge Cases) and FR-001 only define fallbacks for *neural* mask failures (Harvard-Oxford coordinates). There is no corresponding FR or SC in the spec that authorizes a hard halt for missing text event boundaries, nor is there a task covering the fallback strategy (if any) implied by the spec's general risk mitigation logic. The task exists without a spec anchor, and the spec lacks the requirement this task enforces.

Tasks T014, T015, and T016 extract timecourses for Left Hippocampus, Right Hippocampus, and DLPFC respectively. While they are tagged [US1], they lack explicit [FR-001] tags. FR-001 explicitly requires extracting timecourses for 'left/right hippocampus and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex ROIs'. The absence of the [FR-001] tag on these specific extraction tasks makes the traceability to the primary functional requirement ambiguous, especially given the analyze report flagged T014/T015 as 'failed/rejected' in a previous context. Explicit tagging is required to confirm coverage.

Tasks T050-T055 reference 'Reviewer Note' and specific dates (e.g., 'Kandel's review (2026-05-31)') in their rationale. These reviewer comments are not present in the provided spec.md or plan.md artifacts. While the tasks themselves are valid work, the lack of a corresponding 'Reviewer Feedback' section or amended FRs in the spec makes the 'Rationale' text in the tasks untraceable to the current source of truth. The spec needs to be updated to include these requirements as FR-008+ or the tasks need to be removed until the spec is amended.
